DRAG DROP -
Drag and drop the keywords onto the URL request to collect all the subnets configured under tenant Production using a REST API. Not all options are used.
theory: APIC REST calls address a managed object at /api/mo/<dn>.json (the 'mo' endpoint targets a specific object by its distinguished name); to pull every subnet configured under a tenant's DN rather than just the tenant object itself, you add the query-target parameter to scope the query into the object's subtree and a target-subtree-class filter so only fvSubnet children are returned — together these parameters turn a single-object lookup into a filtered subtree search for one specific class of child object. (Cisco documentation / web research)
